title: Repository pattern for sessions
discoveries: SQL CASE WHEN pattern for null-safe text concatenation with char(10) newline - essential for streaming output logs
calculateDuration as sync helper on repository object for computing session elapsed time from timestamps
inArray from drizzle-orm for multi-status filtering in findActive - returns only pending and running sessions
withTransaction support for transactional operations across multiple session updates
Comprehensive test coverage (31 tests) validates all CRUD paths, SQL patterns, and schema constraints
what_worked: Pattern reuse from featureRepository (F013) and projectRepository (F012) - copied structure exactly, zero adaptation needed
31 comprehensive tests created covering all methods: CRUD operations, calculated fields, SQL concatenation edge cases, and schema constraints
Low risk assessment was accurate - zero retries, single commit, clean first pass
appendOutput SQL pattern tested with 3 sequential appends validating newline handling
calculateDuration implemented as pure sync function, tested with and without database context
Schema constraints validated: NOT NULL on featureId/status/startedAt, nullable on completedAt/output/error
recommendations_for_next: For future repositories, use session.ts or feature.ts as the template - both established the standard Drizzle CRUD pattern
Consider extracting status strings ('pending', 'running', 'completed', 'failed') into shared constants file for findActive-style methods
appendOutput SQL pattern is production-ready and reusable for any text column concatenation with newlines
The two-method pattern (findByStatus for single status, findActive for multiple statuses via inArray) should be standard
withTransaction pattern enables future multi-step operations with rollback capability
code_patterns_added: DB-015: SQL text append with null safety using CASE WHEN
success_factors: Well-defined acceptance criteria in feature spec
Clear template from F012/F013 to follow
